assumptions.EY: published central-value comparisons only; uncertainty unqualified; no SD/h_C propagation or exact brew ratio
assumptions.allowance: TOTAL declared per-condition perturbation; not measured error, SD, SE, CI, tolerance or added rounding allowance
assumptions.chemical_operator: refractometer aliquot; three samples; C_bar=sum(C_j)/3; E_bar=sum(C_j/r_j)/3; r_j=dose_j/beverage_j
assumptions.dependence: one common original-condition collection; no probabilistic independence; overlapping marginal extrema need not be jointly attainable
assumptions.duration: reported condition duration; statistic, spread, rounding and clock convention unknown
excluded: independent confirmation from TDS and EY
assumptions.exposure: sources and preliminary contrasts inspected before PLAN; not preregistered or protected
assumptions.grind: ordinal within coffee; Optimal recipe-defined; no calibrated cross-coffee or Cameron mapping
assumptions.illustration: h_C=0.05 pp and h_tau=0.5 s are conditional illustrations, not authenticated measurement bounds
assumptions.lineage: thesis Table 4.3 = Egidi Table 2; sole canonical identity egidi2024/table2
assumptions.native_format: all three tables: TDS means one decimal; EY means two; TDS SD format varies
assumptions.observation_unit: original published condition summary; join is not raw-shot pairing
assumptions.pressure: native nominal machine labels; reference, sensor node and actual history unknown
assumptions.sigma: reported TDS SD; estimator unspecified; descriptive, including printed zero
assumptions.strict_sign: combine coefficients first; [L0-s*h,L0+s*h]; nonzero L0,s>0: 0<=h<abs(L0)/s; equality unresolved
assumptions.temperature: exact source setting; not measured puck temperature history
assumptions.ties: printed zero is not physical equality; structural identity s=0 has zero radius for all allowances
